verdict.rationale: Canny ships AI features such as Autopilot, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it can consume external MCP servers; the axis applies. The evidence only documents Canny's own MCP server, which lets ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor reach Canny data. That is the server role and earns no credit for a client-side story where Canny would plug in other MCP servers and use their tools. Nothing in the pack shows Canny acting as an MCP client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
